name: LumenTech Electronics
description: Premium D2C store for laptops, monitors, and computing accessories aimed at professionals, students, and gamers.

products.name: LumenBook Pro 15 Business Laptop
products.description: A 15.6-inch business laptop built for professionals who work on the move. Slim aluminium chassis, Intel Core i7, 16GB RAM, and a 512GB SSD. Its 15-inch display and full-size body pair naturally with a well-padded 15-inch carry solution for daily commutes and business travel.

products.name: LumenBook Air 13 Ultrabook
products.description: An ultra-thin, feather-light 13.3-inch ultrabook weighing under 1kg. Designed for students and frequent flyers who value a slim profile. The compact 13-inch form factor slides easily into a slim sleeve or minimalist carry case.

products.name: LumenBook Predator 16 Gaming Laptop
products.description: A powerful 16-inch gaming laptop with an RTX GPU, 32GB RAM, and a high-refresh 165Hz display. It is a large, heavy machine that needs a spacious, rugged bag with reinforced protection for its charger and peripherals.

products.name: LumenClick Wireless Mouse
products.description: An ergonomic wireless mouse with silent clicks and a rechargeable battery. A small everyday accessory that travels alongside a laptop and needs a dedicated pocket or small organizer to avoid getting lost in a bag.

products.name: LumenType Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: A compact 75% mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches and RGB backlighting. Popular with professionals who carry their own keyboard between home and office and want it protected in transit.

products.name: LumenSound NC700 Noise-Cancelling Headphones
products.description: Over-ear active noise-cancelling headphones with 40-hour battery life, ideal for flights and open offices. These premium headphones benefit from a hard protective case to prevent damage while travelling.

products.name: LumenDock 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
products.description: A 7-in-1 USB-C docking hub with HDMI, ethernet, and card readers. It ships with several cables and adapters that clutter a laptop bag unless kept in a dedicated cable organizer.

products.name: LumenDrive 1TB Portable SSD
products.description: A pocket-sized 1TB external SSD with USB-C and read speeds up to 1050MB/s. A small, valuable gadget that professionals carry daily and want stored safely in a padded pouch.

products.name: LumenView 27 4K Monitor
products.description: A 27-inch 4K UHD monitor with USB-C power delivery for a clean single-cable desk setup. A stationary desk product for home-office and studio workstations.

products.name: LumenCam 4K Streaming Webcam
products.description: A 4K webcam with autofocus and a built-in privacy shutter for video calls and streaming. A compact desk accessory often carried between locations by hybrid workers.
